Things like Zyprexa (olanzapine) , Risperdal (risperidone), Seroquel (quetiapine) all have the side effects of being tired and gaining weight/getting hungry all the time. Why is this?
Why does anti-psychotic medicine (neuroleptics) make you incredibly tired and hungry?

Unfortunately there isn't a great answer for this.

All these drugs antagonize dopamine receptors, and serotonin receptors. Dopamine are the same receptors involved in level of consciousness (sleep/wake) areas of the brain. While you decrease effects of psychosis by blocking these receptors, you affect other parts of the brain.

In terms of increased appetite the answer is probably similar but I cannot say exactly why, or how, or where the effects are happening. It could be effects happening in the gut.
Serotonin receptors impact hunger. When you modulate these receptors you can increase feelings of hunger or decrease them depending on which receptor type the drug targets. Its all in the brain man~
